headline: CVS Health Explores Splitting Retail Pharmacy and Insurance Businesses
summary: CVS Health is exploring a potential split of its retail pharmacy and insurance businesses, according to a Financial Times report.
why: CVS Health is a major healthcare and retail pharmacy conglomerate; structural breakups can unlock shareholder value and reprice distinct business segments.

impacts.name: CVS Health
impacts.why: Potential breakup plans often lead investors to reassess the sum-of-the-parts valuation of the conglomerate.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The prospect of separating core operating segments hints at strategic repositioning to maximize shareholder value.
